caption: The drawing features a standing wooden frame with intricately twisted uprights and a notched horizontal support at the top and bottom. The frame is composed of dark brown wood and stands on an ornate, scrolling tripod base. The central part of the frame holds a square needlework or tapestry panel, bordered with a twisted wood design, showing a scene with a red-upholstered chair to the left, a table covered in a red cloth in the center, and a large blue peacock on the right. Behind the table is a vase or jug, and the background contains foliage from a tree with green and brown leaves. The ground or floor under the depicted scene features a checkered pattern in shades of brown and cream. Off to the lower left of the main image, there's a small, pale line drawing diagram of the stand and its structure. The entire composition is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Fire Screen
